answer_1.quote: Obtaining singable lyric translations can facilitate the globalization of the music publishing industry ... However, song translation is unusually difficult for human translators ... If we can construct lyric-specific machine translation (MT) systems ...

answer_2.quote: The following metrics are used for objective evaluation: Sacre-BLEU, TER, length accuracy (LA), rhyme accuracy (RA), and word boundary recall (BR).

answer_4.quote: We employ five students from a local university with music performance or lyric composing backgrounds. We let participants evaluate outputs on five-point scales and take the average as the final score.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluations are from four dimensions: (1) sense, (2) naturalness, (3) music-lyric compatibility, (4) Singable Translation Score (STS).
